note: The 8 financial/domain axes (22-axis canon). Same spine, same three-state grammar. The three index candidates are DECLARED with rubric + bank status; all UNMEASURED until their public input banks exist and are recomputable. Provenance-controls MEASURED (deterministic on-chain facts, v2 signed run).

axes.name: On-chain control facts
axes.rubric: deterministic on-chain facts: allowlisting (RequireAuth), freeze capability (NoFreeze absent), identity domain, issued supply

axes.name: Reserve attestation present
axes.rubric: is a third-party reserve attestation (Deloitte/PwC/etc.) publicly published and current? deterministic Y/N + date

axes.name: Declared regulatory framework
axes.rubric: is the governing regime declared and confirmable (MiCA/UCITS/Reg D/BVI)? deterministic Y/N

axes.name: Represented vs distributed
axes.rubric: RWA.xyz distributed-vs-represented classification + holder count; flag represented>>distributed (JMWH pattern) deterministically

axes.name: Named custodian/auditor
axes.rubric: are custodian + auditor named and confirmable? deterministic Y/N

axes.name: AI economy index
axes.rubric: Deterministic index over cited public AI-economy series (compute prices, AI investment, adoption, AI-sector output). Formula + inputs published; stranger-recomputable. Bank: declared — NOT BUILT.
axes.bank_status: NONE — declared only; measure when the public input bank is assembled (proposed: sources listed in the rubric doc)
axes.declared_as: CANDIDATE financial-axis slot (22-axis canon extension); UNMEASURED until the public input bank + formula are published and strangers can recompute. Never claimed before measured.

axes.name: Human-labour index
axes.rubric: Deterministic index over cited public labour-series (employment, hours, wages, displacement indicators). Formula + inputs published.
axes.bank_status: NONE — declared only; measure when the public input bank is assembled
axes.declared_as: CANDIDATE financial-axis slot (22-axis canon extension); UNMEASURED until the public input bank + formula are published and strangers can recompute. Never claimed before measured.

axes.name: Humanoid-labour index
axes.rubric: Deterministic index over cited deployment/utilisation series (installed fleet, active deployments, hours worked, safety-incident rates per deployment).
axes.bank_status: NONE — declared only; measure when the public input bank is assembled
axes.declared_as: CANDIDATE financial-axis slot (22-axis canon extension); UNMEASURED until the public input bank + formula are published and strangers can recompute. Never claimed before measured.

honesty: 3 candidate axes (ai-economy, human-labour, humanoid-labour) have NO rubric and NO data yet — declared UNMEASURED so the slot is honest and public, never claimed as built. They become MEASURED only when a deterministic rubric + real data exist and a run is signed.
